topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can’t believe I’ve been nothing but supportive, listening to all those tales about late nights and projects, and it turns out, it was all just... a story. A web of lies. I kept asking, curious about the details, proud of their supposed achievements, and every word was just painted on, like a facade that’s starting to peel. Now, I’m supposed to just nod and smile? No. Not this time. I’ve got questions, and I want more than just another made-up answer. It’s time for the truth, no matter what color it is.
